The '''Extorin sector''' was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Extorin Major system/Legends|Extorin Major system]] and the [[Extorin Minor system/Legends|Extorin Minor system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The latter shared its name with the [[Extorin Minor skirmishes]], a conflict that involved the group known as the [[Extorin]] and that was waged<ref name="Gamer8">{{GamerCite|8|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Priapulin}}</ref> at some point by [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{GamerCite|8|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Priapulin}} indicates the [[Extorin Minor skirmishes]] occurred at some point prior to the events of ''[[Rogue Planet]]'', which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].</ref>

By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Extorin [[Sector/Legends|sector]] bordered the [[Thand sector/Legends|Thand sector]] northward, the [[Montitian Grant sector/Legends|Montitian Grant sector]] westward, the [[Cantons of Lahag/Legends|Cantons of Lahag]] southward, and the [[Great Agash sector/Legends|Great Agash]] and [[Trans-Jardeen sector/Legends|Trans-Jardeen sectors]] eastward.<ref name="Expansion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Extorin sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed its Extorin Major and Extorin Minor systems in grid square J-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
